C1.worst_defect: Hero says "Point of sale for Vendure" with a pre-release badge and clear CTAs, but nowhere says who should not use it or how it differs from Shopify POS, Square, Lightspeed or a Vendure-native alternative; a buyer comparing tills gets no positioning.

C2.worst_defect: Footer says "MIT licensed", yet "To build and host it yourself instead of using app.vendurepos.com, you need your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)" — the free open-source self-host path depends on a paid third-party licence whose cost is never stated. Also: changelog admits "in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder" (shipped twice, documented not fixed), last plugin release 2026-10-06 (0.2.0 and 0.3.0 same day), and no maintainer, support channel or roadmap statement anywhere.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 (Setting up the store); connect-a-till; limitations; changelog.desktop.01

C3.worst_defect: Quick start is thorough but long (9 steps, 9 phone slices) and step 6 changes the store-wide tax strategy that "also affect[s] the web shop"; step 4 needs a manual ReadOrder workaround for a known plugin bug; no one-command starter or example store.

C4.worst_defect: Changelog is written in internal jargon a buyer cannot parse ("ADR 0005", "order.create v5", "TallyPosV51790900000000"); a leftover legacy note "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app" remains in the quick start; Tally* code names and ph.wcpos.com analytics add a third and fourth brand to explain.

C5.worst_defect: Below the two evidence cards, the home feature list is a dense text grid with no visuals, so the page loses momentum after the hero; dark mode otherwise holds up.

C6.worst_defect: none found beyond length: quick start runs to 9 phone slices; code wraps and tables stack legibly.

C7.worst_defect: Quick-start LCP 2.6 s with the largest-contentful-paint audit failing (0.88) and 53 KiB unused JS on home; everything else (llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, 404, search API) is in place.

overall_worst.defect: "MIT licensed" till whose self-host path requires "your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)" — a paid proprietary dependency with no price or terms given, which a sceptic would flag to a client as a hidden cost and lock-in to app.vendurepos.com.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 (Setting up the store); footer "MIT licensed"
overall_worst.fix: Next to "MIT licensed" and on the self-host instructions, state plainly that self-hosting needs a paid RxDB Premium licence, what it costs or link its pricing, and that app.vendurepos.com is the free alternative; add a short who-maintains-it / support line.
